title: Dance through a missed beat
situation: Two dancers march the same eight-beat phrase. On beat five Bola lifts the wrong foot, stalls, glances at Shim, and catches up with two half-beats so she lands back in phase on beat seven rather than restarting.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
ledger: hartswf0/bolas T117 (Dance through a missed beat)
cardboard cut-out pieces (cast/dummy/ bola, shim, dot)
